sentences.text: Researchers employed a computational model of a neural network containing the subthalamic nucleus and two types of globus pallidus neurons to investigate the generation of specific brain rhythms.
The simulation indicated that a loop connecting the subthalamic nucleus and prototypic globus pallidus neurons serves as the primary mechanism for creating and maintaining abnormal brain activity.

While arkypallidal neurons strengthened this activity by inhibiting prototypic cells, activating only the prototypic neurons stopped the abnormal coupling, whereas activating the arkypallidal neurons had no effect.
Consistent changes in measures of brain synchronization and power suggest that this coupling can serve as a reliable signal for monitoring brain state.
These findings identify the prototypic neuron group as a potential target for precise light-based brain stimulation treatments.
